feeds.title: Style Curator
feeds.description: Welcome to STYLE CURATOR where it's all about the home! See latest home decorating & design, renovation ideas, DIYs, real home tours & interviews with experts in the industry. Welcome to Style Curator, your destination for daily interiors inspiration. Their mission is the pursuit of a stylish home and through their articles and videos, you'll find all the motivation and info you need to create the stylish home you've always dreamed of.

feeds.title: DIY Floorboards Blog
feeds.description: DIY Floorboards is an Australian-owned and operated business, and we deliver Australia-wide. DIY Floorboards is the leading online store in flooring across Australia. We provide the best cost-benefit for people who like to do things by themselves.

feeds.title: The Painted Hive
feeds.description: The Painted Hive blog is dedicated to budget-friendly DIY ideas for interior design and home decoration with a focus on real projects, fresh ideas, and evocative inspiration. Author Kristine writes crispy articles focusing on real projects, fresh ideas, and evocative inspiration. She loves the creative challenge and self-satisfaction which comes from decorating on a budget.

feeds.title: Julia Bobbin
feeds.description: Covers articles about exploring fashion of all vintages and dress patterns of all types, by a vintage loving, fabric obsessed sewing enthusiast author Julia Bobbin.

feeds.title: Eight Acres Blog
feeds.description: This is a blog by Liz Beavis and I share posts about self-sufficiency and permaculture in rural Australia including cattle, house cows, chickens, garden, farming, handmade natural soap, scratch cooking, and house renovation. Our mission at Eight Acres is to help you to become a producer instead of a consumer.

feeds.title: Art Masterclass Blog
feeds.description: Art Masterclass is the world's most popular mosaic art studio. We are Australia's first workshop to teach the art of traditional Turkish mosaic lamp making. Examine our Blog in order to get informed about new design ideas and techniques at artmasterclass.com.au!

feeds.title: Biome Blog
feeds.description: Biome's vision is to preserve a safe, healthy environment on this wonderous planet for now, and for those who come after us. Since 2003, we've been obsessed with finding solutions to environmental problems and scrutinizing products to uncover green-washing, hidden toxins, and dubious ingredients.

feeds.title: Inspired DIY Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to Inspired DIY, your one-stop shop for all your DIY renovation needs! We are a small team of passionate professionals located in Australia, dedicated to helping customers bring their renovation visions to life. We started Inspired DIY with the goal of providing DIY enthusiasts with access to amazing, high-quality, and affordable materials to help make their renovation projects a success.

feeds.title: BuildTuff DIY & Ideas Blog
feeds.description: We reimagine traditional products and through rigorous testing create an improved version made with superior features. With all aspects of the manufacturing controlled by us, we ensure our products are delivered to an exceptional standard. Our wide range of product systems offers solutions for existing issues and issues you didn't know you had. From small to large building jobs, our products have a place within them all. We invite you to discover a smarter way to work, with BuildTuff.

feeds.title: My Poppet Makes
feeds.description: Cintia is the creative mind behind My Poppet Makes, a craft blog that recognizes the possibility in the ordinary. She writes about DIY projects, kids' crafts, inspirational craft tutorials, fabric, and sewing.

feeds.title: Katrina life+design » DIY/How to
feeds.description: Katrina from The Block - Interior Design and Lifestyle blogger in Australia. Lover of budget interior design and DIY projects. My blog is about helpful home styling and practical tips. I am addicted to finding floor plans and I'm crazy about crystals. Writing every day since 2006.
